actual_request.prompt:
EDIT TARGET is image 1: the neutral STANDING bamboo archer girl. Image 2 is original identity; image 3 is the approved primary painting/material style. Make one complete new animation frame of this exact girl. Keep head, face, green eyes, gentle closed-mouth smile, high dark brown ponytail, jade and gold leaf clasp, pale ribbons, outfit, front yin-yang buckle, green/ivory/gold ornate boots, long bamboo bow held by LEFT hand at chest height, and quiver over RIGHT shoulder. Only two arms and two legs. Match her steady upper body, facial identity and equipment. Fixed front-right three-quarter SOUTH-EAST view facing down-right, both eyes visible, same 2.4-head chibi proportion, orthographic camera. Change ONLY the leg and hip articulation to the requested genuinely distinct relaxed walking pose. No copying, mirroring, offsetting or warping an existing pose. Image 4 is solely LEG SKELETON/OVERLAP and foot-silhouette pose guide, not boy identity or clothing. Rebuild girl's two legs and own ornate boots from that articulated guide. Output a newly rendered full single figure, native square >=1024x1024, genuine transparent alpha, all hair/bow/boots fully in frame with transparent safety margin. No ground shadow, background, text, grid, watermark, blur or extra objects. Highest available clean rounded detailed Chinese fantasy painting, exact original garment and boot materials.
Frame 06: early forward swing of the near leg after passing. Match image 4's leg arrangement: the SCREEN-LEFT BOOT is lifted and advanced in front of the screen-right leg, knee bent, toes slightly up, a small sliver of sole visible. SCREEN-RIGHT BOOT remains LOWER and firmly supporting weight, planted below the right side of the shorts. Unlike the idle pose, draw a clear lifted forward leftmost boot, not a lifted boot on the right. Leftmost thigh emerges from screen-left shorts and bends forward; shin connects naturally to its raised boot. Rightmost leg is the nearly straight planted support. Keep stride small: lifted boot no more than 1/3 boot-height above support sole; no high kick.
